decisions.briefing: Markets were mildly negative today (NASDAQ -0.8%, S&P 500 -0.6%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($489.29) sits just below the $500 buy threshold, and per past lessons we don't force a buy into idle slots on a neutral day — holding existing 7 positions and waiting for a genuine risk-on setup with stronger multi-signal confirmation.

market_education.summary_en: Both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 slipped modestly today, reflecting a broadly cautious, low-conviction trading session rather than any single dramatic catalyst. Moves of under 1% like this typically indicate investors digesting recent gains or waiting for the next batch of economic data rather than reacting to major news. With no strong directional signal, staying patient and preserving cash is often the more disciplined choice.
market_education.summary_zh: 納斯達克指數及標普500指數今日均溫和下跌，反映市場氣氛審慎，交投缺乏方向，並非受單一重大事件觸發。像今日這種不足1%的波動，通常顯示投資者正在消化早前升幅，或等待下一批經濟數據公佈，而非對重大新聞作出反應。在缺乏明確方向訊號的情況下，保持耐性、留存現金往往是較穩健的做法。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today's neutral market and below-threshold cash balance are a textbook case for holding that reserve rather than forcing a trade — patience preserves optionality for a better setup.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指投資者預留在場邊的現金，待出現理想機會時才動用。今日市況中性，現金餘額亦未達買入門檻，正是應該保留這筆儲備、而非勉強交易的典型情況——耐心等待能為日後更佳的入市時機保留彈性。
